previous_versions.body: 7.5.1. comes close , but is missing is the part where the victim must also be notified of such a change on the old mail address (and/or phone number if that is used for authentication purposes). When changing other datapoints that _aren't_ means of contacting the account owner (MFA config, password), this change should also be communicated to them, of course, but what you don't want is an attacker doing these changes unnoticed after performing the full re-authentication.
